logger.doc:name: Start Get orders

db:select.doc:name: Retrieve order
db:select.db:sql: SELECT o.id_order, o.id_customer, o.order_date, o.status, o.total_price, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, p.id_product AS id, p.id_spoonacular, p.name, p.title, p.image, p.servings, p.health_score, p.likes, p.cost, p.price, p.stock, p.diet, p.waiting_time, p.ingredients, p.instructions, p.chef FROM ${db.orders_table} o JOIN ${db.order_items_table} oi ON o.id_order = oi.id_order JOIN ${db.products_table} p ON oi.id_product = p.id_product WHERE o.id_order = :id

logger.doc:name: DEBUG- After Retrieve orders

validation:is-not-empty-collection.doc:name: Le produit existe en BDD?
validation:is-not-empty-collection.message: Le produit recherché n'existe pas en base de données

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { id_order: payload[0].id_order, id_customer: payload[0].id_customer, orderdate: (payload[0].order_date as Date) as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}, status: payload[0].status, totalprice: payload[0].total_price, items: payload map (item) -> { quantity: item.quantity, unitprice: item.unit_price, product_details: { id_product: item.id, id_spoonacular: item.id_spoonacular, name: item.name, title: item.title, image: item.image, servings: item.servings, health_score: item.health_score, likes: item.likes, cost: item.cost, price: item.price, stock: item.stock, diet: item.diet, waiting_time: item.waiting_time, ingredients: read(item.ingredients default "[]", "application/json"), instructions: read(item.instructions default "[]", "application/json"), chef:item.chef } } }

logger.doc:name: End Get Orders
